## Preview review
Vercel preview URL:
Reviewed commit SHA:
Reviewer and date:
- [ ] Actual deployed preview checked, including console and network failures
- [ ] Desktop Chrome / Firefox / Safari
- [ ] iPhone Safari / Android Chrome / tablet
- [ ] Width changes, orientation, fast scrolling, halfway refresh
- [ ] Keyboard-only and reduced-motion reading path
- [ ] Back/forward, internal links, missing routes, slow loading
- [ ] No obvious layout shifts, broken media, stuck or overlapping animation
- [ ] Lighthouse reports reviewed; outstanding issues recorded

Do not mark a milestone complete with a failing check, absent preview review, or untested required device. Engine emulation is not real-device Safari/Chrome review.
